idea.title: First slide: weak hook vs strong hook
idea.angle: Text-only before/afters: 'House for sale' becomes '4-bed with a pool'. 'Apartment available' becomes 'Quiet 2-bed near the mall'.
idea.hook: YOUR FIRST LINE: BEFORE AND AFTER

slides.heading: YOUR FIRST LINE: **BEFORE** AND AFTER
slides.body: One line decides if they stop.

slides.heading: "HOUSE FOR SALE" SAYS **NOTHING**
slides.body: Buyers decide in about a second whether to keep looking. A plain first line gives them no reason to stop.

slides.heading: THE **FAMILY** HOME
slides.body:
Before: "House for sale."
After:
✓ "4-bed with a pool, quiet street"
✓ The size comes first
✓ One standout feature
✓ A reason to stop

slides.heading: THE CITY **APARTMENT**
slides.body:
Before: "Apartment available."
After:
✓ "Quiet 2-bed near the mall"
✓ Says how big it is
✓ Says where it is
✓ Says why it's nice to live in

slides.heading: THE **RENTAL**
slides.body:
Before: "Nice house for rent. DM for info."
After:
✓ "3-bed family home, close to schools"
✓ Speaks to the right renter
✓ Answers their first question

slides.heading: WHAT A STRONG FIRST LINE **HAS**
bullets: Size: the bedroom count, house or apartment.
Area: the street, or what's close by.
Standout: a pool, a garden or a view.

slides.heading: SAME LISTING. ONE BETTER **LINE**.
slides.body: Put it on your first photo and in the first 3 seconds of your video.

slides.heading: WRITE A FIRST LINE THAT **STOPS** THEM
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
"House for sale" is not a hook. It's a label.

Buyers decide in about a second whether to keep looking.
Your first line has to tell them why this home is worth their time.
Say the size, the area or the standout feature.
"4-bed with a pool, quiet street" stops people. "House for sale" doesn't.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
